title: Why Nathan's Hot Dog Record Keeps Climbing
hook: The hot dog eating record used to be 25. Now it's 76.
closing: Nobody has beaten 76 yet, so someone is surely training to be next.
question: Could you eat 10 hot dogs that fast?

segments.say: Nathan's hot dog contest used to be won with 25. Today's record is triple that, so eaters keep pushing human limits.
In a stomach study, a normal eater tapped out early. A competitive eater ate 36 hot dogs before researchers stopped him.
The record of 76 still stands. The latest winner fell short, which shows how hard it is to beat.
